description: Send an endpoint against an environment and return the real response (status, headers, body up to 20 KB). A `local` environment goes through the user's tunnel to their localhost (the CLI must be running); staging/prod are sent from Pipehero's cloud (Pro/Team) to public addresses only. Sending to a `prod` environment with a write method needs confirm_write_to_prod: true, which you should only pass after the user agrees. Use it to check that the code you wrote behaves as documented.

endpoint_id.description: Id of the endpoint. Alternative to method + path.

environment.description: Environment name or id, e.g. local.

method.description: HTTP method of the route, e.g. POST. Use with path instead of endpoint_id.

path.description: Route path as written in the code, e.g. /v1/charges/:id or /v1/charges/{id}.

variables.description: Values for {{variables}} the environment doesn't define, e.g. {"id": "ch_123"}.

name: run_api_endpoint
